description: This file defines the SimpleActivatorMenu class, a Unity MonoBehaviour script that manages a simple scene menu for toggling active game objects and updating a GUI text element.

classes.name: SimpleActivatorMenu
classes.description: A Unity MonoBehaviour class that provides functionality to switch between scene objects and update UI text accordingly.

methods.name: OnEnable
methods.description: Initializes the active object index and updates the GUI text when the script is enabled.

methods.name: NextCamera
methods.description: Cycles to the next object in the array, updates their active state, and updates the GUI text with the new object's name.
